{{DISPLAYTITLE:cooleo1c}}
'''cooleo1c''' is credited with the original concept of one [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card prints the credit as "Original concept by cooleo1c, PC Volunteer Award 2009". The credited card is [[Carnor Jax, Royal Guard|•Carnor Jax, Royal Guard]], in [[Virtual Block 6]] (released 2009).
